profile.headline: Software Engineer, UX Designer, and Accomplished Pianist
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Anthony! I enjoy programming, website design, computer hardware, networking, gaming, film editing, and just about anything creative and full of new technology.

My passion is making something previously considered impossible into a reality. When that new reality is impactful, it is incredibly fulfilling. Through graphic design and software development, a new digital experience can change a person's life.  I'm always proud to be a part of that.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Skills: Angular · API Development · Software Development · UX Design · TypeScript

positions.title: President
positions.description:
- Provide small businesses and startups with a full identity design, including a logo, color scheme, typography, and stationary design.
- Design high-quality websites for small businesses using the latest web design and scripting practices.
- User Experience design for web applications
- Create powerful motion-graphics works for films and advertisements.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Digital Media Group
positions.description:
- Developed comprehensive software solutions for both internal and client use.
- Technologies include JavaScript, SCSS/SASS, Laravel PHP Framework, Vue.JS, React, and MySQL
- Product design using modern web practices and UX research

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained the Sony Professional website
- Designed and developed new sections of the website with backwards-compatible HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Worked with product databases
- Designed web interfaces for Sony mobile products

positions.title: Back-End Software Developer
positions.description:
Chorus is a mobile-first social network for collaborative songwriting

- Developed the server for the Chorus iOS app
- Technologies used include PHP and MySQL
- Used custom PHP Framework to develop a RESTful server API

positions.title: Web Designer & Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for designing & developing code for online training materials using JavaScript, XML, CSS3, and HTML5

- Responsible for designing print materials for clients using Adobe InDesign and Adobe Illustrator

honors.title: 1st Place Hackathon Winner
honors.description: At a Hackathon at Kean University in New Jersey, I developed a web-based MIDI instrument interface that listens to a live performance and reacts to proactively placed triggers in the music.  It was designed using Google Chrome Canary's bleeding-edge technology, and utilized HTML5, JavaScript, and jQuery.

honors.title: Kean Xpedition Music Video Contest - 1st Prize
honors.description:
This music video was chosen as the winner of a contest held by Kean Xpedition, an on-campus media organization at Kean University.

It was filmed using a Canon Vixia HFR10 camcorder and edited with Adobe Premiere and Adobe After Effects.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Provided essential information and guidance for guests in the variety of exhibits in the museum.
- Assisted with creating and managing group events.
- Provided assistance in the IMAX Dome Theater by preventing the projector lenses from gathering dust and other visible material.

- Assisted in a variety of film shoots by setting up and calibrating the camera, sound, and light equipment.
- Used Final Cut Pro to edit raw footage that was provided for projects ranging from television spots to movie trailers.
- Used Adobe After Effects to create logo animations for the company and some of its projects.

projects.title: MoodRing
projects.description:
MoodRing is a sentiment analysis and mood detector designed as a Google Chrome browser extension.  It scans the latest posts of your Facebook friends and displays an emoticon representing each of your friends' moods.

• Placed Top 10 from over 100 teams at the Accelerate 2015 Hackathon in San Francisco
• Incorporated HP's Idol on Demand API for sentiment analysis
• DOM manipulation using jQuery to append emoticons to users based on their moods
• Used intensive pair-programming to integrate all source code

projects.title: vanBranity
projects.description: vanBranity is a social network project that aimed to connect the photo-sharing style of Instagram with brand marketing.  It was designed to allow every user to have a voice with their favorite brands.
